name: Open Optical Orders
query:
SELECT
 name AS "Order:Link/Optical Order:140",
 customer_name AS "Customer::170",
 cost_center AS "Branch:Link/Cost Center:130",
 expected_delivery AS "Expected Delivery:Date:120",
 status AS "Status::110",
 payment_status AS "Payment Status::110",
 net_total AS "Net Total:Currency:110",
 outstanding_amount AS "Outstanding:Currency:110",
 GREATEST(DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), expected_delivery), 0) AS "Days Overdue:Int:100"
FROM `tabOptical Order`
WHERE status IN ('Confirmed', 'In Production', 'Ready')
ORDER BY expected_delivery
